# Introduction {-}

This portfolio was created using the bookdown package as part of the DSFB2 course. 

The content of this portfolio is as follows:

- Professional Profile & Career Vision

- Comparison of ORA and GSEA Workflows for RNA-seq Enrichment Analysis in R

- Data management

- Reproducible science 

- ggplot2: ravenplot 

- Parameterized Rmarkdown report: The number of COVID-19 cases in Europe

- Project Leptospira 

P.s. Although I made the stylistic choices myself, the custom CSS file was created with AI assistance.
